ai-swimsuit-model-cli-skill 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Transform a person photo into a swimsuit model image using the WeShop CLI.
- Requires installation of weshop-cli and a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Supports prompts and batch processing for image generation.
- API key is handled securely via environment variable only.
